kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تشابهت (form VI)
# تَشَابَهْتُ (tašābahtu) /ta.ʃaː.bah.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَشَابَهَ (tašābaha)
# تَشَابَهْتَ (tašābahta) /ta.ʃaː.bah.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَشَابَهَ (tašābaha)
# تَشَابَهْتِ (tašābahti) /ta.ʃaː.bah.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَشَابَهَ (tašābaha)
# تَشَابَهَتْ (tašābahat) /ta.ʃaː.ba.hat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
